heading:
THE APOSTOLIC TRADITION OF HIPPOLYTUS

TRANSLATION
paragraphs:
LAT1. ¹We have duly completed what needed to be said
about “Gifts”, describing those gifts which God by His
own counsel has bestowed on men, in offering to Himself
His image which had gone astray. ²But now, moved
by His love to all His saints, we pass on to our most important
theme, “The Tradition”, our teacher. ³And we
address the churches, so that they who have been well
trained, may, by our instruction, hold fast that tradition
which has continued up to now and, knowing it well,
may be strengthened. ⁴This is needful, because of that
lapse or error which recently occurred through ignorance,
and because of ignorant men. ⁵And [the] Holy
Spirit will supply perfect grace to those who believe
aright, that they may know how all things should be
transmitted and kept by them who rule the church.
